# Trade evolutions

Every Pokémon that evolves by trading can also evolve without a trade here (trading them with a friend still works):

- a plain trade evolution happens at a level instead;
- a trade holding an item becomes using that item from the Bag, like an evolution stone (the item can still be held);
- Karrablast and Shelmet evolve when they level up with the other one (or its evolution) in the party.

| Pokémon | Evolves into | How |
|---|---|---|
| Kadabra | Alakazam | reach level 36 |
| Machoke | Machamp | reach level 38 |
| Graveler | Golem | reach level 35 |
| Haunter | Gengar | reach level 35 |
| Boldore | Gigalith | reach level 35 |
| Gurdurr | Conkeldurr | reach level 35 |
| Poliwhirl | Politoed | use a King's Rock |
| Slowpoke | Slowking | use a King's Rock |
| Onix | Steelix | use a Metal Coat |
| Scyther | Scizor | use a Metal Coat |
| Seadra | Kingdra | use a Dragon Scale |
| Porygon | Porygon2 | use an Up-Grade |
| Porygon2 | Porygon-Z | use a Dubious Disc |
| Rhydon | Rhyperior | use a Protector |
| Electabuzz | Electivire | use an Electirizer |
| Magmar | Magmortar | use a Magmarizer |
| Dusclops | Dusknoir | use a Reaper Cloth |
| Feebas | Milotic | use a Prism Scale |
| Clamperl | Huntail | use a DeepSeaTooth |
| Clamperl | Gorebyss | use a DeepSeaScale |
| Karrablast | Escavalier | level up with Shelmet in the party |
| Karrablast | Escavalier | level up with Accelgor in the party |
| Shelmet | Accelgor | level up with Karrablast in the party |
| Shelmet | Accelgor | level up with Escavalier in the party |

Items with no other source in Hoenn (and the Metal Coat and Dragon Scale) are sold at the Lilycove Department Store, 3F: Up-Grade, Dubious Disc, Protector, Electirizer, Magmarizer, Reaper Cloth, Prism Scale, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale.
